blind.description: A garden bean wigwam / teepee trellis composed of multiple wooden poles tied together near the top with wrapped cord or rope. Climbing runner bean vines with broad green leaves and bright red-orange blossoms spiral up each supporting pole. The geometry is clean, stylized, and solid, with leaves and flowers securely attached to the vine stems. The poles rest directly on their ends on the ground without an artificial base plinth.
blind.from_above: Resembles a four-pointed cross or starburst of green leaves with red blossoms radiating from a central cluster of wooden pole tops tied together.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.5 to 5.0 ft tall (reaching just below the chin of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 ft wide at the base.
